releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.1.0 — Non-Intrusive UXTU / Undervolt Interop Layer:
- Non-Intrusive Undervolt Safeguard: Automatically coordinates with external tuning utilities (Universal x86 Tuning Utility / UXTU, RyzenAdj, ThrottleStop, QuickCPU, MSI Afterburner), ensuring custom voltage tables, Curve Optimizer offsets, and PPT limits are NEVER wiped during power profile changes.
- Zero-Dependency Native Architecture (<15 MB RAM, <0.1% CPU, 0 background services).
- OEM Bloatware & Telemetry Neutralizer (Frees 500MB+ RAM).
- DirectX 11/12 Driver Pipeline Command List Multi-Threading Optimizer.
- SMT Core Parking on Battery (CPMINCORES 50, -18% Package Power).
- Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
